captions.detailed: A cylindrical bedroom-scale air purifier consisting of a lower gray body and an upper light-gray shell. The front of the lower body features a small rectangular white power button housing with a black circular button, while the upper shell has a blue rectangular status light or badge on its side. The top of the upper shell is designed with a circular ventilation grille. The upper shell is rotatable around the vertical axis, while a cylindrical filter inside can be pulled upward, and the front power button can be depressed.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a cylindrical bedroom air purifier. It should feature a main lower body with a small rectangular power button on the front, and an upper twist-off shell with a circular ventilation grille on top and a blue status indicator on the side. Ensure the upper shell is rotatable, the internal filter can slide out vertically, and the power button is depressible.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a Cylinder primitive, adding a small Box for the power button housing and a smaller Cylinder for the button itself. Model the upper shell using a Cylinder, subtracting crossed slots at the top to form the ventilation grille, and adding a thin Box for the blue indicator. Define the internal filter as a separate Cylinder. Establish a revolute joint for the upper shell's rotation, a prismatic joint for the vertical extraction of the inner filter, and a prismatic joint for the power button's compression.
